description.value: Miracle Beach Nature House is an interpretive nature center within Miracle Beach Provincial Park on Vancouver Island, situated on the coast between Courtenay and Campbell River. The park features a broad sandy beach with rich tide pools at low tide, about 2 km of walking trails through second-growth and old-growth forest, and access to the Black Creek estuary. Touring cyclists on the Oceanside Route (Hwy 19a) can reach the park via a short 2 km side road from the highway.
